# The `just check` aggregate inventory for livespec-orchestrator-beads-fabro, in the aggregate's own order.
# It MUST list exactly the members of the justfile `check:` recipe's targets,
# in the same order; the `check:` recipe refuses to run when the two differ.
#
# Every member carries an `incident-timing` class, read by livespec-dev-tooling's
# expedited incident hooks (EXPEDITED_INCIDENT_RESPONSE) and nothing else. The
# aggregate's reader drops every comment, so annotations never change what
# `just check` runs.
#
# Each recipe was run alone, in sequence, capped at 90 s, on vps (vmi3006760,
# 18 cores) on 2026-11-13, at load 47-82: the method livespec-dev-tooling
# used for its own inventory (livespec-dev-tooling-oqpw6t). A member that took
# 45 s or more, or hit the cap, is `slow` and is deferred on the expedited
# path; 45 s leaves a 25% margin under the hooks' 60 s per-gate bound. A member
# whose first time was slow but within reach of the threshold was re-timed
# alone at lower load (38-70), and the faster run classifies it: `slow` defers the
# gate, while a fast gate that overruns 60 s is still recorded as a deferred
# timeout, so the faster reading is the safer one. A gate that encodes a
# normal-path precondition an incident commit cannot meet by design is
# `not-applicable` and names that precondition. Both `slow` and `not-applicable`
# gates are recorded as DEFERRED, with their reason, in every expedited
# receipt, and both still run in the full `just check` aggregate.
# 87 are `fast`, 7 `slow` and 7 `not-applicable`. The slowest of the rest:
# check-all-declared 37.6 s; check-fresh-clone-setup 35.5 s; check-heading-coverage-debt-register 34.8 s.
# A new member needs a measured class; a missing one is unclassified and deferred.
#
# Shipped members declare their purity in their own livespec-dev-tooling module;
# each repo-private member carries a `# purity:` declaration here, so the
# green-token reader can classify the whole aggregate. `tree-pure`: the
# committed tree alone decides the verdict. `world-reading`: state outside the
# tree can change it (a host tool or home directory, or the ledger).
check-agents-ai-references-resolve  # incident-timing: fast
check-aggregate-completeness  # incident-timing: fast
check-all-declared  # incident-timing: fast
check-assert-never-exhaustiveness  # incident-timing: fast
# check-branch-protection-alignment reads this repository's live branch protection
# from the forge, which needs a credential with admin read on the repository: a
# soft host dependency. Deferred for an incident (legacy-coordinator-agent's ruling,
# 2026-11-13, from fleet-flaky-tests' sweep); `just check` and CI still run it.

# check-codex-skill-picker is a live, authenticated Codex TUI acceptance, host-dependent
# by design. With no `codex` on PATH it skips with exit 0, because
# dev-tooling/just-check-codex-skill-picker.sh probes `command -v codex`. On a host WITH
# codex it drives the real TUI against the host's ~/.codex home and installed plugin, and
# fails when that home is not prepared (for example a missing ~/.codex/tmp). Deferred
# for an incident (legacy-coordinator-agent's ruling, 2026-11-13); work item 7qb2bs
# (fleet-flaky-tests) makes it hermetic. `just check` still runs it, and CI's aggregate
# job invokes it, where it exits 0 unless LIVESPEC_REQUIRE_CODEX_TUI_PICKER=1.
check-codex-skill-picker  # purity: world-reading  # incident-timing: not-applicable # incident-precondition: authenticated-codex-cli-with-installed-plugin
check-no-fleet-pat-dispatch-surface  # purity: tree-pure  # incident-timing: fast
check-spec-governance-default-block  # purity: tree-pure  # incident-timing: fast
check-seam-equivalence  # purity: tree-pure  # incident-timing: fast
check-ci-wires-repo-local-gates  # purity: tree-pure  # incident-timing: fast
# check-fabro-graph-validity hands the workflow graphs to the host's `fabro validate`,
# so its verdict depends on the host's fabro build: a soft host dependency. It
# probes for the binary through resolve_fabro_bin, then shutil.which or an
# executable-file check (dev-tooling/checks/fabro_graph_validity.py). Deferred for
# an incident (legacy-coordinator-agent's ruling, 2026-11-13); fleet-flaky-tests owns
# pinning fabro. `just check` and CI still run it.
check-fabro-graph-validity  # purity: world-reading  # incident-timing: not-applicable # incident-precondition: a-host-fabro-cli
